name: Shimri
overview: The name Shimri appears in Scripture associated with several individuals who held positions of leadership and service within Israel. Among them is a head of a family in the tribe of Simeon, highlighting the importance of family leadership and growth (1 Chronicles 4:37-38). Shimri is also noted as the father of one of King David's mighty men, emphasizing his connection to the king's elite warriors (1 Chronicles 11:45). Additionally, a Merarite chief named Simri, though not the firstborn, was appointed leader by his father, illustrating God's providence in appointing leaders beyond birthright (1 Chronicles 26:10). Lastly, a Levite named Shimri served during King Hezekiah's reforms, reflecting faithful service in temple duties (2 Chronicles 29:13). Together, these references reveal Shimri as a name linked with faithful leadership and service in God's covenant community.
